metadata.name: blackbox
metadata.description: BLACKBOX: strategies executed inside a MagicBlock Private Ephemeral Rollup. Alpha you can't read.

accounts.name: round
docs: Writable: activation counts the license in `open_licenses`.

accounts.name: feed
docs: is owned by the delegation program).

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: The round's custody token account (vault + pot), owned by the Round PDA.

accounts.name: owner_ata
docs: The user's delegated USDC (their ATA address on the ER).

accounts.name: custody_ata
docs: Entrant PDA custody (its ATA address on the ER).

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Round PDA vault (its ATA address on the ER).

accounts.name: custody_ata
docs: Custody token account owned by the Entrant PDA (margin lives here on the ER).

accounts.name: round
docs: Sponsor of the chat account (debited once, refunded by close_chat).

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: round
docs: Writable: the scheduled tick writes it, and a CPI cannot escalate privileges.

accounts.name: funder_ata
docs: The funder's USDC on the ER (their ATA address).

accounts.name: owner_ata
docs: The owner's USDC on the ER (their ATA address).

accounts.name: to_ata
docs: Destination chosen by the admin (on the ER), e.g. the house wallet's ATA.

accounts.name: strategy
docs: Private strategy (read-only here).

accounts.name: position
docs: Private position.

accounts.name: strategy
docs: The author's private strategy: read by the program, never by the buyer.

errors.name: BadRoundStatus
errors.msg: round is not in the expected status

errors.name: BadOracle
errors.msg: price feed account is invalid, stale, or for another feed

errors.name: BadEata
errors.msg: bad ephemeral ATA or delegation PDA

errors.name: NotDelegated
errors.msg: account is not delegated or not on the expected validator

errors.name: LicenseLimit
errors.msg: license limit reached for this author

errors.name: CrankInactive
errors.msg: crank task guard: round not live

errors.name: BadChat
errors.msg: chat message must be 1-79 printable bytes

errors.name: LicensesOpen
errors.msg: every active license must settle first

types.name: Entrant
docs: Public per-entrant record (delegated).

fields.name: strategy_hash
docs: sha256 of the final bytecode, written only at settlement.

fields.name: fee_price_bps
docs: Blind-priced license fee (bps of notional per mirrored trade); public.

types.name: Hall
docs: Hall of Fame (L1 only).

fields.name: size
docs: Notional, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: entry
docs: Entry mark, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: side
docs: +1 long, -1 short, 0 flat.

types.name: License
docs: A licensee's mirror of an author's strategy. Delegated, PRIVATE to
buyer + author, zero-copy. The crank runs the author's bytecode against
these legs; neither the buyer nor anyone else can read the bytecode.

fields.name: margin
docs: Margin held in the license's custody token account, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Realized PnL net of license fees.

fields.name: mem
docs: The author's strategy memory, separate per licensee.

fields.name: accrued_fees
docs: Fees owed to the author, paid at settlement.

fields.name: ran_tick
docs: Round tick + 1 of the last executed tick (0 = never): one run per tick.

types.name: Market
docs: Live per-market state (delegated, public, zero-copy). Indicators are
maintained once per tick here so every strategy's reads are O(1).

fields.name: mark
docs: Mark price, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: vol
docs: Realized volatility over the ring, scaled fraction (1e6 = 100%).

fields.name: ret_sq_sum
docs: Running sum of squared per-tick returns over the ring (scaled 1e12),
maintained incrementally so volatility costs O(1) per tick.

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: Static per-market config stored on the Round (public).

fields.name: feed
docs: Oracle price account (Pyth Lazer PriceUpdateV2 pushed by MagicBlock).

fields.name: decimals
docs: Price decimals in the oracle account (8 for Pyth Lazer majors).

fields.name: skew_spread_bps
docs: Extra spread per 100% of skew, in bps.

fields.name: oi_cap
docs: Open-interest cap per side, USDC notional (6dp).

types.name: Position
docs: Trading state. Delegated, PRIVATE to the owner, zero-copy.

fields.name: margin
docs: Margin held in the entrant's custody token account, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: mem
docs: VM persistent memory.

fields.name: sum_ret
docs: Rolling Sharpe accumulators (per-tick equity returns, scaled).

fields.name: ran_tick
docs: Round tick + 1 of the last executed tick (0 = never): one run per tick.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global protocol config (L1 only).

types.name: Round
docs: A round of the league. Delegated to the TEE for its whole life; public.

fields.name: tick
docs: Tick counter advanced by `tick_clock`.

fields.name: open_licenses
docs: Activated licenses not yet settled; close_round and sweep_vault require 0.

fields.name: live
docs: Crank guard: scheduled instructions no-op when false.

fields.name: pot
docs: Entry fees collected (USDC 6dp), paid out at settlement.

fields.name: vault_balance
docs: Solvency beacon: what the vault holds vs what entrants are owed.

types.name: Scoreboard
docs: Leaderboard (zero-copy). Delegated; public in Lit mode, private
(program-only) in Dark mode.

types.name: Strategy
docs: The strategy. Delegated, PRIVATE to the owner, zero-copy. Bytecode never
touches L1 in plaintext: created zeroed, filled on the ER, scrubbed before
undelegation.
